# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com is a comprehensive online dictionary and thesaurus platform offering word definitions, language resources, and educational games across web and mobile platforms.

Dictionary.com provides language reference tools and support resources for users accessing the service on Android, iPhone, and web browsers. The platform includes daily games and puzzles powered by Arkadium, with multilingual support including Spanish-language content.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and word meanings
- Thesaurus and synonyms
- Mobile apps (Android and iPhone)
- Daily word games and puzzles
- Crosswords and Sudoku
- Spanish language games (juegos diarios)
- User support and FAQs
- Solitaire and online games
- Language learning resources
- Arkadium game platform
- Word reference tools
- Educational puzzles

## Help & Support

- [Dictionary.com Help Center](https://help.dictionary.com/): Help center for Dictionary.com and Thesaurus.com users

## Optional

- [Juegos Diarios en línea gratis | De Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/es/categoría/diario): Spanish daily games section with puzzles, crosswords, and Sudoku
